requestId.description: The request to poll. Optional: an applicant whose first reply was lost never received an id, and the id-less poll — resolved from the authenticated applicant's own DID — is the only form available to them. Supply it when you have it; a consumer that has it MUST prefer it over inferring the request from the caller.

code.description: Stable refusal code, safe to branch on. Present only when `status` is `rejected`.

reason.description: Elaboration in prose, when the decider gave one. Present only when `status` is `rejected`.

decidedAt.description: When the refusal was decided — not when this poll was produced. Present only when `status` is `rejected`.

needs.description: When deferred, what the applicant must supply next.

presentationDefinition.description: When more evidence is needed, the presentation-definition to satisfy (opaque here).
